integrity: The positive order-one side follows from nonsingular irreducible M-matrix theory and preservation of constants. The higher-order obstruction follows from an exact rank-one Sherman-Morrison inverse at the minimal sample size. A standard-library exact-rational checker independently replays the finite algebra and strict witnesses.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for the standard unweighted equally spaced Whittaker-Henderson quadratic smoother with identity fidelity weights and ordinary forward differences. Weighted fidelity, irregular grids, constrained variants, and modified boundary penalties are outside scope.
title: Only first-difference Whittaker–Henderson smoothing is universally range-preserving
